channel.title: Dronedeploy incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Dronedeploy's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: BIM upload and processing failures [resolved]
item.description: Between 2026-08-24 00:51 UTC (Aug 23, 4:51 PM PT) and 2026-08-25 13:20 UTC (Aug 25, 6:20 AM PDT) some users may have experienced failures with local uploading or processing of BIM files. Engineering has corrected the issue and no further impact is expected.

item.title: Dock Automation: Some Dock drones offline/unable to take off [resolved]
item.description: Between 12:41 PM PT on 08/23 and 09:21 AM PT on 08/24 (19:41 UTC on 08/23 and 16:00 AM UTCon 08/24) some users may have noted their Dock showing as offline or their dock drone being unable to launch. Engineering has corrected the issue and no further impact is expected.

item.title: Safety AI Reports failing [resolved]
item.description: Between 1:45AM PDT on Aug. 7th and 1:00PM PDT on Aug. 8th (2026-08-06 08:00 UTC - 2026-08-07 18:00 UTC), some users may have experienced failures in export of Safety AI reports. Engineering has implemented a fix and does not anticipate any additional impact.

item.title: Intermittent issues loading elevation layer [resolved]
item.description: Between 7:45AM and 1:20PM Pacific Time (14:45 and 20:20 UTC), some users may have experienced issues with rendering the elevation layer. Engineering has made changes to prevent further impact.

item.title: Projects not loading [resolved]
item.description: Between 1:00PM and 1:40PM Pacific time (20:00 and 20:40 UTC) some users may have experienced issues loading projects in DroneDeploy, as well as latency or errors when attempting to use DroneDeploy on web or mobile. If you attempted to upload or export during this window, please try your action again.

item.title: DroneDeploy web and mobile apps unavailable [resolved]
item.description: Between 9:15AM and 10:30AM Pacific Time (16:15 and 17:30 UTC) some users may have been unable to access DroneDeploy on web and mobile, due to an outage with one of our service providers. Our Engineering team implemented a patch to restore service and continued to monitor stability until the service provider issue was confirmed resolved. We expect no further impact.

item.title: BIM file upload failures during processing [resolved]
item.description: Between 9:00AM Pacific Time on 06/26 and 2:57PM Pacific Time on 06/29 (16:00 UTC on 6/26 and 21:57 UTC on 06/29), some users may have experienced BIM upload processing failures. Engineering has corrected the underlying issue. Please try your upload again.

item.title: Errors when pulling data from or pushing data into Procore [resolved]
item.description: Between 07:00AM and 12:15PM Pacific time (14:00 and 19:15 UTC), some users may have seen errors when attempting to import or export data between DroneDeploy and Procore. The issue has been resolved, but affected users will see missing data backfill between now and Monday. We appreciate your patience.

item.title: Unable to complete initial setup of integration with Autodesk Construction Cloud [resolved]
item.description: Between 9:18PM on 6/21 and 6:07AM PDT on 6/22 some users may have experienced issues with the Autodesk integration not working as expected. The issue has been resolved and no further impact is expected.

item.title: dronedeploy.com unavailable [resolved]
item.description: Between 1:07PM and 1:27PM Pacific Time (20:07 and 20:27 UTC) some users may have experienced a 500 error when attempting to access dronedeploy.com. This was due to a service issue with a third party software provider. The issue has been resolved and our team will continue to monitor to ensure ongoing stability.

item.title: Enterprise Analytics dashboard unavailble [resolved]
item.description: Between 12:00PM and 2:23PM Pacific Time (19:20 and 21:23 UTC) some users may have been unable to access the Enterprise Analytics Dashboard. Engineering has deployed a fix and confirmed the issue is resolved.

item.title: Intermittent telemetry issues [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: All integrations currently not working as expected [resolved]
item.description: Between 2:51AM and 9:02AM Pacific Time (9:51 and 16:02 UTC), some users may have experienced issues with integrations not working as expected. Engineering has corrected the issue and no further impact is expected.

item.title: Unable to load elevation layer on cut/fill, location, annotation, report, and export data impacts [resolved]
item.description: Between 4:40 PM Pacific Time on 05/05 and 1:20 PM Pacific Time on 05/06 (23:20 UTC on 05/05 and 20:20 UTC on 05/06), some users may have experienced issues loading elevation data, as well as related impacts to location data, annotations, exports, and reports. The underlying issue has been corrected and no further impact is expected.

item.title: Unable to embed projects in Procore [resolved]
item.description: Between 11:00AM PT and 4:30PM PT, some users may have experienced an issue where they got an error when attempting to embed a DroneDeploy project into Procore. This issue has been resolved. Please try your embed again.

item.title: Some aerial data uploads failing when using Smart Uploader [resolved]
item.description: Between 08:00AM Pacific on 04/14 and 12:09PM Pacific Time on 04/20 (04/14/26 15:29pm UTC and 04/20/2026 19:05pm UTC), some users may have experienced failures when attempting to upload aerial data using the desktop Smart Uploader. Engineering has rolled back the change that caused the issue and no further impact is expected. If you had a failure during this window, please try your upload again.

item.title: Login via Procore and Autodesk not working on web app [resolved]
item.description: Between April 16 and 17, some users may have experienced an issue logging in to DroneDeploy's web app via Procore or Autodesk. Engineering has resolved the underlying issue and login via these methods are now working as expected.

item.title: DroneDeploy Support unable to receive inbound email [resolved]
item.description: Between 6:30AM and 4:30PM Pacific Time (14:30 and 00:00 UTC), emails sent to DroneDeploy Support may not have been received due to an outage with our third-party ticketing system provider. This issue has been fully resolved and emails sent throughout the day are backfilling into our inbox. We appreciate your understanding.

item.title: Some aerial data uploads failing when using Smart Uploader [resolved]
item.description: Between 12:53PM Pacific on 03/30 and 12:30PM Pacific Time on 03/31 (18:53 UTC on 03/30 and 18:30 UTC on 03/31), some users may have experienced failures when attempting to upload aerial data using the desktop Smart Uploader. Engineering has rolled back the change that caused the issue and no further impact is expected. If you had a failure during this window, please try your upload again.

item.title: Safety AI Reports not being delivered [resolved]
item.description: Between 2:30am and 2:37pm Pacific Time (09:30 and 21:37 UTC), some users may have experienced an issue where Safety AI reports were not delivered. Engineering has resolved the underlying defect, and reports are now being delivered as expected. All undelivered reports will be run retroactively. There is no need to resubmit your request. Thanks for your patience.

item.title: Delays in Safety AI report delivery [resolved]
item.description: Safety AI is no longer experiencing delays with report delivery. We appreciate your patience.

item.title: Robot service calls failing [resolved]
item.description: Between 1:45PM and 3:05PM Pacific Time (21:45 - 23:05 UTC), some users may have noted failure of robot service calls. Engineering has taken action to resolve the issue.

item.title: Safety AI Delayed Processing [resolved]
item.description: Between 02/11/2026 at 1:00PM PST (21:00 UTC) and 02/13/2026 at 12:28AM PST (08:28 UTC), new Safety AI reports were not being delivered due to a partial outage with a third-party vendor. Engineering has made updates to address the issue, and all queued reports are being reprocessed. We appreciate your patience.

item.title: Ground App standard photo upload issue [resolved]
item.description: Between Wednesday, Feb. 4, 10:38 AM PST and Friday, Feb. 6,11:15 AM PST (Feb. 04, 18:38 - Feb. 06, 19:15 UTC), when users uploaded multiple standard photos at once, only one photo per level/project was saved, and the rest of the photos in that batch did not reach our servers. The issue has been resolved by our engineering team, and new uploads are now working normally.

item.title: Outdated Enterprise Analytics Data [resolved]
item.description: A fix has been implemented to ensure a complete refresh of all Enterprise Analytics dashboard data. Please allow several hours for the dashboard to fully refresh.

item.title: Projects not loading on Ground App v2.229.0 [resolved]
item.description: Between 8:24AM and 3:45PM Pacific time (16:24 and 23:45 UTC) some users may have experienced issues loading projects in the DroneDeploy Ground App. Engineering has resolved the issue and no further impact is expected. We appreciate your patience.

item.title: Export delays [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Export failures [resolved]
item.description: Between 4:00PM and 5:25PM PT (00:00 - 01:25 UTC) some users may have experienced export failures. All failed exports have been restarted. Please allow a couple of hours for exports to complete.

item.title: Intermittent PPK Processing failures due to third party provider instability [resolved]
item.description: Between 1:00PM PST on 12/09 and 1:00AM PST on 12/11 (21:00 UTC on 12/09 and 09:00 UTC on 12/11), some users may have had PPK map processing failures due to an outage with our third-party PPK processing partner. All failed maps are being queued for reprocessing. Please allow several hours for the backlog to clear. No action by the user is needed.

item.title: Dock Drones not writing flight logs [resolved]
item.description: On Sunday, November 30th, between 4:00pm and 8:40pm PST (12/01/2025 00:00 and 4:40 UTC), some users may have noted that flight logs were not uploaded to Dock Drones. The issue was corrected and flight log data captured during that window is being backfilled. Please allow a few hours for that data backfill to complete.
